follow_up.span: TIME FRAME: From the day of randomization in the interventional part of the trial until the individual day of end of study in the non-interventional part of the trial. Up to 1869 days. | POPULATION: Randomised set (RS): included all randomised participants, whether treated or not.

served_mismatch: The served HR 0.72 (95% CI 0.64 to 0.82) describes the interventional trial at median 2.0 years. The requested longest trial-reported follow-up is held in registry outcome 7: overall study including post-trial follow-up, up to 1869 days, HR 0.79 (95% CI 0.72 to 0.87).

candidate_rejections.span: During a median of 2.0 years follow-up, a primary outcome event occurred in 432 of 3304 patients (13.1%) in the empagliflozin group and in 558 of 3305 patients (16.9%) in the placebo group (hazard ratio, 0.72; 95% CI 0.64 to 0.82; P<0.001)
candidate_rejections.why: Valid primary-composite result for the shorter interventional period; does not represent the longest follow-up held in the packet.

entry_population_matches_question.why: Eligible participants were adults with impaired kidney function or albuminuric CKD; the selected registry analysis includes all randomized participants.

notes: Registry spans are used because the full text does not report the longer overall-study estimate. This includes non-interventional post-trial follow-up. The registry's overall-study composite description omits ESKD and specifies decline of more than 40%, whereas the interventional definition includes ESKD and decline of ≥40%; these definitions are not silently harmonized.
